title: CLAUDE.md — HowMaHiCo
text: LC-immunopeptidomics (MHC/HLA peptide) data-analysis project: parameterized RMarkdown reporting pipeline ingests LC-MS search-engine output (FragPipe, DIA-NN, PEAKS), normalizes one unified long-format table (pep_all), renders self-contained interactive HTML QC reports plus csv/xlsx/png result exports. Current version: 0.18.0 — Phases 1–6 package conversion complete. v0.18.0 added protein-level table report (R/prot-.R + 08_prot_all): build_prot_all() condenses pep_all one row per (protein, Sample) — ligands contributed, summed Area (linear-scale sum log2, build_quant_matrix() , Log2Area average get_mat_log2area() uses), unique-peptide counts previously unused Is_Unique/Proteotypic flags, protein annotation. protein key param (ProteinFeature: ProteinFirst default | GeneFirst | Accession) Accession protein group DIA-NN PEAKS; MultiMapping (leading default | ) chooses ligand maps several proteins counted, expand_mapped_proteins() resolving engine-specific mapped-protein column via Found_By. Engine-reported protein-level values carried : prot_engine_columns() finds DIA-NN’s PG.*/Genes.* quantities q-values (already pep_all, previously unused) build_prot_all() carries unique-within-group rule returns NA rather averaging value genuinely varies; plot_ligand_vs_protein_quant() compares summed ligand intensity. parse_diann()’s protein-column selection moved dplyr::any_of(diann_protein_columns()) report using either DIA-NN naming generation (PG.Quantity vs PG.Abundance) keeps quantities instead silently dropped — aborting parse. Descriptive : differential testing (use 06_quant_stats QuantFeature = "ProteinFirst") length normalisation, needs FASTA (see Deferred designs). Note protein count need match 01_id_counts, counts n_distinct(Accession); report says explicitly. v0.17.0 distributability pass: report header attribution longer hardcoded. Every skeleton branded output one platform (“provided Immunopeptidomics Platform (IPP)”, plus personal @dkfz.de address **Code author:** DGZ line two 00_* reports); nine templates now declare optional Provider param render line new exported provider_line() (R/report-helpers.R), falls back generic sentence naming organisation Provider empty. Called namespaced (`r HowMaHiCo::provider_line(params$Provider)`) two 00_* templates header sits inline setup chunk, package attached yet. Also new: inst/scripts/howmahico_pipeline.R + exported get_pipeline_script() (sibling get_report_template() / get_dictionary_template()) — runnable, commented walkthrough renders via run_howmahico_report() rather opening template, starts demo mode running end--end inst/extdata/sim_fragpipe_dda user data; package’s first vignette (vignettes/howmahico.Rmd, VignetteBuilder: knitr), gives pkgdown site Articles tab. README corrected expanded — headline example passed Title param template declares, rmarkdown errors undeclared params, primary documented entry point failed copy-paste. v0.16.1 fixed pkgdown site build, failed every master push since v0.8.0: pkgdown aborts exported function missing _pkgdown.yml reference index, v0.9.0–v0.13.0 added 15 exports without indexing . devtools::check() never reads _pkgdown.yml pkgdown workflow runs master, break visible merge — tests/testthat/test-pkgdown-index.R now guards ordinary suite (exports ⊆ index, stale entries, duplicates; walks find .Rbuildignored _pkgdown.yml skips source tree reachable). v0.16.0 added peptide-chemistry report 07_pepchem engine R/pepchem.R — first part HowMaHiCo describes ligands made rather . pepchem_by_sample() reduces pep_all distinct Sequence per Sample attaches descriptors peptide_properties() (GRAVY, pI, Charge, MW, Boman, HydrophobicMoment, InstabilityIndex, AliphaticIndex + frac_* amino-acid class fractions), computed unique sequences; aa_composition() aa_position_frequency() give position-independent per-position residue tables (latter generalises anchor_information_content(), two now share .aa_alphabet() / .resolve_positions()). unit analysis sample, peptide: summarise_pepchem() collapses sample one value per descriptor, aggregate_pepchem() gives per-Condition mean ± sd across samples, compare_pepchem(level = "sample") tests across samples (Kruskal-Wallis + pairwise Wilcoxon, BH within contrast, MedianDiff + new scale-free cliffs_delta()). test deliberately low-powered — 3 vs 3 samples two-sided Wilcoxon reach p < 0.1, structural limit 06_quant_stats documents Fisher track — level = "peptide" reported alongside explicitly pseudo-replicated, descriptive track. compare_aa_frequency() applies machinery per residue per-sample frequencies (chi-square pooled residue counts, treat every residue independent draw). New plots R/plots.R: plot_aa_composition() (bar / heatmap / log2 enrichment vs. pooled composition), plot_aa_position_heatmap(), plot_property_distribution(), plot_property_sample_summary(), plot_property_effectsize(). New dependency Peptides (CRAN, GPL-2, Rcpp ) Imports — vectorised canonical GRAVY implementation, scales re-derived; Peptides::aaComp() used (per-sequence list) per-descriptor “unrecognized amino acid types” warnings consolidated one. Peptide position within parent protein deferred — see Deferred designs . Two silent-failure fixes found verifying : () ggsave_rawr() / ggprint_rawr() resolved plot name bare exists(), searches helper’s frame outwards (namespace → globalenv()) never reaches report’s knit env (new.env(parent = globalenv())) — PlotsSave = TRUE wrote png report ggprint_rawr() returned warning string instead plot, swallowed warning = FALSE chunks. name now resolved caller’s frame via shared internal .plot_was_built() (R/theme--save.R), non-symbol argument (plots[[nm]], export-loop idiom) judged value NULL plot skipped; (b) 05_quality_score never rendered — inline `r ...` expression ended bare comma-separated string list instead paste0() call, syntax error caught inline-parse time, test rendered template. guarded new tests. v0.15.0 robustness + schema pass driven plans_dgz.md. Mouse MHC-: MHCclass accepts "MHC1_mouse" (7–11 AAs) next MHC1 (8–13) MHC2 (12–25); windows/palettes now come mhc_length_window() / mhc_class_palette() new R/report-helpers.R instead three copy-pasted lists skeletons plus fourth inside .cross_class_range(). quality score follows: mouse, frac_9mer counts 8- 9-mers (H-2Kb favours 8-mers, H-2Db 9-mers) label “8/9-mer fraction” higher cut-offs (quality_thresholds_default() gained mhcclass arg), anchor motif scored whichever two lengths dominates — metric keys unchanged. Three abort/silent-failure fixes: () single-Condition subset longer kills every report — combn(conditions, 2) replaced exported condition_pairs() (empty list one Condition, self = TRUE overlap matrix diagonal); (b) -zero-Area dataset longer aborts — get_mat_log2area() returns 0 x n matrix warning correlation chunks test cor() (errors 'x' empty); (c) get_annot_sampleid() warns nothing/annotation matched HyStar sample list gained keep_all = TRUE (left join). TestMode rebuilt: files read full reduced ~100 rows per run (subsample_testmode() R/utils-loaders.R) instead first 100 lines file — combined FragPipe psm.tsv old behaviour kept first run broke annotation join. One annotation format every engine: read_annot() accepts canonical Sample_folder column derives Sample_fp (verbatim) Sample_peaks (PEAKS-normalized) , loaders untouched legacy CSVs still load; get_annot_fragpipe()/get_annot_diann() emit Sample_folder, PEAKS gained get_annot_peaks(). v0.14.0 added advanced-quantification report 06_quant_stats engine R/quant-stats.R — first part HowMaHiCo compares conditions rather describing . build_quant_matrix() collapses pep_all feature × unit log2 matrix (Area summed precursors linear scale, technical replicates averaged BioReplicate), filter_quant() → normalize_quant() → impute_quant() → test_differential() (limma ~ 0 + Condition pairwise contrasts eBayes(trend = TRUE, robust = TRUE), dependency-free Welch "ttest") → test_detection() (Fisher exact detection counts) → combine_quant_results() / summarise_significant(), plus permanova_condition() (base-R Anderson-2001 pseudo-F permutation test). Missing values run two tracks: quantitative test observed (imputed) values, presence/absence track condition-exclusive ligands whose fold change undefined — flagged detection-count rule, FDR cut-, 3-vs-3 Fisher test go p = 0.1. limma Suggests dependency, guarded internal .require_limma(); report falls back StatMethod = "ttest" / NormMethod = "median" automatically absent. New plots R/plots.R: plot_completeness(), plot_missing_heatmap(), plot_intensity_dist(), plot_dynamic_range(), plot_pca(), plot_quant_heatmap() (clustered/unclustered ggplot2 tile map — plot_heatmap() writes png printed tabset), plot_volcano(), plot_ma(), plot_pvalue_hist(), plot_sig_summary(). report carries “Methods & justification” section. Also fixed: run_howmahico_report("05_quality_score") unreachable (documented absent match.arg choices) — 05 06 now registered test-report-templates.R guards every shipped template directory offered. v0.13.0 plots/exports pass driven plans_dgz.md: plot_pseudochromatogram() now fills RT bars peptide count (density gradient) instead per-Condition colour; new plot_pseudomobilogram() (count vs invk0, configurable binwidth, default 0.2) added next wired 03_lcms_qc (new “Pseudomobilograms” tab RT/1k0/mz view config) 00_mhc_report; plot_charge_proportions() bars gained black outline; peptide-motif window extended 7–25 AAs (01_id_counts/00_mhc_report, capped 24); subset prefix now applied every result filename via shared result_prefix (= Subset, NULL unset) passed write.csv_rawr() / write_input_params() seq_by_condition.xlsx write (e.g. dda_all_pep_all.csv; input_params combines subset + report name avoid collisions). “implement safeguard conditions/replicates give 0 areas” item moved standby (repro). v0.12.0 focused-report polish pass (new engines): 01_id_counts gained Average +/- sd per BioReplicate section mirroring per-Condition one (plot_count_mean_sd() gained group_var arg, default "Condition"); Proportion length content pulled 2nd-level section Condition / BioReplicate / Sample tabs (previously nested Total-sections). 02_overlaps gained Overlap intra-Condition (%) section (plot_overlap_intra_condition() gained value arg, "count"/"percent"). Across focused templates, “Selected peptides” headers now show active length window (e.g. “(8 13 AAs)”) via shortpep_range, “Proteins” ID-level headers/labels renamed “Parent proteins” — display : data keys (counts_levels, n_Proteins columns, count_lim$Level) plot axis labels unchanged (separate counts_labels display vector backs renamed headers). InteractivePlots/ggplotly toggle remains -list. v0.11.0 added cross-class (MHC1↔︎MHC2) contamination dimension quality score: frac_cross_class flags MHC-II ligands co-enriched MHC-pulldown (vice versa) length signature — fraction peptides class’s canonical window (MHC1 8–13, MHC2 12–25) falls outside current window (internal .cross_class_range() single source truth; “outside-current” qualifier handles 12–13 AA overlap). Scored lower_better low weight (small tail biologically normal), NA/dropped custom length windows. New plot plot_cross_class_length() (per-sample length histogram cross-class region highlighted) + “Cross-class contamination” section 05_quality_score report. v0.10.0 added per-sample immunopeptidomics quality score (inspired author’s HowDirty contamination score, inverted — scores strongly sample resembles real HLA immunopeptidome). New engine R/quality-score.R exports score_sample_quality() (per-sample composite 0–100 + traffic-light category), qc_metrics_by_sample() (raw signals: length-window fidelity, 9-mer dominance, anchor-motif clarity via anchor_information_content(), non-tryptic specificity, charge plausibility, depth, mass accuracy — pep_all, external data, new dependency), score_curve(), quality_thresholds_default(), calibrate_thresholds_from_qc(); plus plot_quality_heatmap() / plot_quality_composite() R/plots.R. non-tryptic signal split: overall C-terminal K/R fraction low-weight diagnostic (HLA-alleles use K/R anchors), scored metric isolates tryptic background --window long-peptide tail. Thresholds use literature defaults calibrated samples tagged QC controls via optional annotation QC column (ThresholdMode = "qc_relative"); undefined dimensions (MHC-II anchors, DIA-NN dummy ppm) drop weighted composite instead penalising sample. New focused report 05_quality_score (inst/rmarkdown/templates/05_quality_score/) renders score cached pep_all like focused reports. tests/testthat/test-quality-score.R covers score_curve() / anchor_information_content() (pure math, synthetic peptide data). v0.9.0 added dictionary-driven unified parser tabular search-engine export tool built-loader can ingested editing YAML dictionary (R coding, new loader). New build_pep_all() branch software = "custom" (dictionary arg) runs read_custom_batch() → parse_unified() → annotate_unified(). dictionary maps raw→pep_all columns, sets Found_By constant, derives shared recipe (Log2Area, Length_range, Nter/Cter, PeptideID, Charge formatting); per-tool transforms (unit conversions, regex extraction, accession splitting) pre-clean responsibilities, dictionary-expressible. New exports: read_dictionary(), parse_unified() (R/parse-unified.R), read_custom_batch(), annotate_unified() (R/loaders-custom.R), get_dictionary_template() (R/get-dictionary.R). Reference dictionaries ship inst/extdata/dictionaries/ (custom_template.yaml + fragpipe.yaml / diann.yaml / peaks.yaml); three built-loaders unchanged. tests/testthat/test-parse-unified.R round-trips parse_unified() FragPipe loader. New dependency: yaml (transitive via rmarkdown). Custom software inline-parsing path two 00_* reports — run build_pep_all("custom", dictionary=...) , render focused reports PepAllSource = "cached". v0.8.0 gave four focused reports PepAllSource param ("cached" | "rda" | "build", via inst/rmarkdown/shared/setup.Rmd) can load default cache, load explicit .rda (PepAllFile), self-build raw results via build_pep_all(); added simulated FragPipe dataset (inst/extdata/sim_fragpipe_dda/, moved data/) tests/testthat/test-sim-fragpipe.R (build_pep_all assertion + first end--end render test focused report). v0.7.1 fixed “Duplicate chunk label ‘setup’” parse error aborted four focused reports: shared inst/rmarkdown/shared/setup.Rmd fenced r-chunk example inside leading HTML comment, knitr parses chunk headers even inside comments (re-including file → duplicate setup). Comment now prose; tests/testthat/test-report-templates.R guards . v0.7.0 renumbered report templates (breaking: template= names change): 01_mhc_report→00_mhc_report, 02_mhc_upsets→00_mhc_upsets, 03_id_counts→01_id_counts, 04_overlaps→02_overlaps, 05_lcms_qc→03_lcms_qc, 06_quant→04_quant; rewrote LC-MS report’s RT/1k0/m_z section single looped results='asis' chunk (config list views × peptide sets) instead eight hand-written chunks. multi-report framework (v0.6.0): new exported build_pep_all() (R/build-pep-.R) extracts raw-file parse/cache step, four focused templates render slice --one 00_mhc_report cached pep_all (loaded via shared inst/rmarkdown/shared/setup.Rmd knitr child). Build cache , render subset. 00_mhc_report/00_mhc_upsets --one reports (parse raw files ); v0.6.1 moved PTM profile 01_id_counts -peptides variant. v0.5.0 split two report sections length match “Average +/- sd” pattern: plot_overlap_intra_condition() now single-plot function (breaking signature: (df, id_col, title, shortpep_range) — (pep_all, pep_short, id_col, ...)), “Overlap intra-Condition” + “Peptides identified per charge” report sections now show peptides / Selected peptides (pep_short) separate nested tabsets. v0.4.0 loader-consistency + report-robustness pass: three loaders now share compute_log2area() (zero Area → NA everywhere, previously 1 FragPipe/DIA-NN NA PEAKS — user-visible behavior change), extract_run_name() (POSIX-safe run-name extraction, longer Windows-backslash-), validate_pep_all() (core-schema guard parser tail) — internal helpers R/utils-loaders.R. 00_mhc_report template (named 01_mhc_report) degrades gracefully partial subsets (single-Condition UpSets, -replicate Area %CV), --one templates gained “Session & provenance” footer, 00_mhc_upsets now declares DataAcquisitionNames param. v0.3.0 best-practices pass: base-package imports declared, exports made public (@keywords internal), NEWS.md added, internal code unified native |> pipe (R floor raised 4.1.0). project-style-guide.md documents target R-package + Docker + Shiny distribution pattern. package layout authoritative — DESCRIPTION, LICENSE/LICENSE.md, NAMESPACE, R/ (100+ exported functions plus report entry point), inst/rmarkdown/templates/ (two Rmd report templates), tests/testthat/ (hand-synthesized fixtures + full testthat-edition-3 suite — loaders, annotation, checks, counting, io-export, overlap-counters, plotting smoke tests), .github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml (Win+Ubuntu CI, green), man/, _pkgdown.yml, .Rbuildignore — library(HowMaHiCo) (devtools::load_all()) gives everything. devtools::check() clean (0 errors/0 warnings). Docker/Shiny/.bat distribution tiers remain (Phases 7–9). original 0_code/-based files moved example/ (gitignored) pre-migration reference copies — longer canonical. RStudio project file: HowMaHiCo.Rproj. Tracked private GitHub repo (DavidGZ1/HowMaHiCo, remote origin); 2_data/, 3_results/, 4_figures/, example/, rendered *.html reports gitignored. R/loaders-peaks-dirs.R holds get_dirs_index_peaks(), internal helper indexes PEAKS export subfolders read_peaks_batch(). originally adapted author’s package deltaProtR (github.com/DavidGZ1/deltaProtR) now native HowMaHiCo code — deltaProtR dependency (Imports/Remotes: entry anywhere: CI/Docker/installs).

text: Required columns (checked read_annot): - Condition, BioReplicate, TechReplicate, Sample — always required - Sample_folder — data subfolder name (e.g. fragpipe_dda_combined/JY), column whatever search engine. engine-specific legacy names Sample_fp (FragPipe/DIA-NN) Sample_peaks (PEAKS) still accepted; least one three required. read_annot() derives missing ones: Sample_fp verbatim copy Sample_folder, Sample_peaks copy PEAKS’ hyphen/space normalization — loaders, key Sample_fp/Sample_peaks, unchanged. user-supplied alias never overwritten - Source_file — required mode = "combined_file" (FragPipe combined PSM, DIA-NN); matches spectrum/run name within subfolder - Sample_ID — free-text human-readable identifier - QC (optional) — flags experiment quality-control samples (TRUE/"QC"); consumed 05_quality_score report mark QC samples , ThresholdMode = "qc_relative", calibrate score thresholds. read_annot passes untouched (schema change needed) get_annot_fragpipe() / get_annot_diann() / get_annot_peaks() generate skeleton table (Sample_folder) respective exports. Matching key joining annotation ↔︎ data: Sample_fp alone fragpipe_dda_individual; Sample_fp + Source_file combined_file mode DIA-NN. read_annot also strips .d/.raw extensions Source_file replaces hyphens/spaces Sample_peaks underscores (matching PEAKS’ export behavior). Factor order downstream plots/tables taken row order CSV (mutate(across((.character), function(x) factor(x, levels = unique(x))))).

title: CLAUDE.md — HowMaHiCo
text: unified long-format table every report section consumes (one row per peptide-sample observation). Core columns: Condition, BioReplicate, TechReplicate, Sample, Sample_ID, Accession/ProteinFirst/GeneFirst/ OrganismFirst, Peptide/Sequence/Length/Length_range, Score, Area/Log2Area, PTM, Charge/Nter/Cter, RT/invk0/Mass/ppm/m_z, Source_file/Source_File_ID/Precursor_Id, Found_By, PeptideID. pep_short subset filtered Length within [ShortPeptideLengthMin, ShortPeptideLengthMax] (8–13 AAs HLA-, biologically expected MHC-ligand length window). pep_all cached 2_data/<Subset>_pep_all.rda (pep_all.rda Subset empty) subsequent runs/inspection don’t require re-parsing raw search files.

text: Render reports library(HowMaHiCo) + run_howmahico_report() — thin wrapper around rmarkdown::render() locates installed package’s report template via system.file() knits fresh environment (avoids params-argument / rmarkdown::render()-injected-params name collision; see R/run-report.R). One call renders one report (composable — loop batch runs; Docker-idiomatic “one container run = one job”): 6-subset batch pattern 0_code/00_knit_reports.R used drive directly — deriving _jy/_plasma annotation CSVs, looping render() {dda,dia} × {,jy,plasma} — preserved \dontrun{} example run_howmahico_report/derive_filtered_annotation (R/run-report.R); latter exported helper annotation-derivation preprocessing step (derive_filtered_annotation("sample_annotation_dda_all.csv", "1_documentation", "JY")). title: Project Style Guide
text: style project follows layered architecture: Distribution tiers (always provide four, ordered easiest → powerful):
code: LC-MS processed data (e.g., PEAKS CSV export, Fragpipe .tsv, DIA-NN .txt or p.parquet)       │       ▼ R functions   — normalise, annotate, threshold, summarise       │       ▼ Parameterised RMarkdown template (inst/rmarkdown/templates/)       — produces a self-contained, interactive HTML report       — all parameters declared in YAML header under params:       — toggle static/interactive plots via params$PlotsInteractive       │       ▼ Multiple csv files — incl. always-written input_params.csv (version + all params) Excel workbook   — summary tables via write.xlsx()

title: Project Style Guide
text: Never put :label inside parenthesised (...) (...) block — cmd.exe silently terminates block label, causing unpredictable early exit. labels must top scope; use goto jump . error paths must converge :error_exit label always calls pause exit /b 1 — keeps window open user can read error. Suppress Docker output >nul 2>&1 daemon checks; show docker pull output user sees progress. Use timeout /t N /nobreak >nul silent waits; never use sleep. Test double-click Windows Explorer (terminal) — PATH CWD may differ.
